risks.risk: Wrong application: the steering rack may not fit the claimed Toyota Camry or RAV4 models.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped part number or casting mark cross-referenced to a Toyota parts catalog, or a compatibility document.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unmatched steering rack with no guaranteed fit.

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage to gears, bearings, or seals.
risks.proof: Video of the rack being cycled by hand, or close-up inspection of gear teeth and bearing play.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or needing a full rebuild.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all boots, seals, and end fittings, or a pressure/leak test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as leaking with seal replacement required.

risks.risk: Incomplete assembly missing tie rods, boots, or brackets.
risks.proof: Photo showing the complete assembly with all accessories and mounting hardware attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a bare rack without accessories.

proof_requests: Photo of any stamped part number or casting mark on the housing.
Video showing the rack moved through its travel to check for binding or knock.
Close-up photos of the boots, seals, and tie rod ends.
Photo showing whether mounting brackets and all accessories are included.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a steering rack, so it can be valued at its worst case despite the seller's conflicting description and unproven condition claims.
